verses.original: וַֽעֲתַלְיָה֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ וְרָאֲתָה כִּ֣י בְּנָ֑הּ מֵ֣ת וַתָּ֙קָם֙ וַתְּאַבֵּ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַמַּמְלָכָֽה׃ זֶ֥רַע
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’êm ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū wə·rå̄·ʾă·ṯå̄h kî bə·nāh mêṯ wat·tā·qām wat·tə·’ab·bêḏ ’êṯ kāl- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh ze·ra‘
verses.literal: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead she proceeded to annihilate - all the royal heirs

verses.original: יְהוֹשֶׁ֣בַע בַּת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ י֠וֹרָם אֲח֨וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֜הוּ אֶת־ וַתִּקַּ֣ח יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֗ה וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַמָּמוֹתְתִים אֹת֥וֹ וְאֶת־ מֵינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַיַּסְתִּ֧רוּ אֹת֛וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·še·ḇa‘ baṯ- ham·me·leḵ- yō·w·rām ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ’eṯ- wat·tiq·qaḥ yō·w·’āš ben- ’ă·ḥaz·yāh wat·tiḡ·nōḇ ’ō·ṯōw mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê- ham·me·leḵ ham·må̄·mō·ṯə·ṯīm ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- mê·niq·tōw ba·ḥă·ḏar ham·miṭ·ṭō·wṯ way·yas·ti·rū ’ō·ṯōw mip·pə·nê ‘ă·ṯal·yā·hū wə·lō hū·māṯ
verses.literal: But Jehosheba daughter of King Joram the sister of Ahaziah - took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away - from among the sons of the king [who were] being murdered - - [She put] him and his nurse in a bedroom . . . to hide him from Athaliah and he was not killed

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י מִתְחַבֵּ֖א אִתָּהּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַעֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî miṯ·ḥab·bê ’it·tāh bêṯ Yah·weh šêš šā·nîm wa·‘ă·ṯal·yāh mō·le·ḵeṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And [Joash] remained hidden with [his nurse] in the house of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled . . . the land

verses.original: הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִית וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע שָׁלַ֨ח וַיִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת לַכָּרִי֙ וְלָ֣רָצִ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ בְּרִ֜ית לָהֶ֨ם וַיַּשְׁבַּ֤ע אֹתָם֙ וַיַּ֥רְא אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ בֶּן־
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘îṯ ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ šā·laḥ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ lak·kā·rî wə·lā·rā·ṣîm way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯām ’ê·lāw bêṯ Yah·weh bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lā·hem way·yaš·ba‘ ’ō·ṯām way·yar ’ō·ṯām ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ ben-
verses.literal: Then in the seventh year Jehoiada sent for . . . - the commanders of hundreds the Carites and the guards and had them brought - - into the house of the LORD [There] . . . he made a covenant with them and put them under oath . . . He showed them - the king’s son

verses.original: וַיְצַוֵּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֤ית מִכֶּם֙ בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְשֹׁ֣מְרֵ֔י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wêm lê·mōr zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śūn haš·šə·li·šîṯ mik·kem bā·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ wə·šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ ham·me·leḵ bêṯ
verses.literal: and commanded them . . . This . . . is what you are to do A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard . . . the royal palace

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר ס֔וּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֥ית בַּשַּׁ֖עַר אַחַ֣ר הָרָצִ֑ים מַסָּֽח׃ וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבַּ֖יִת
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šə·li·šîṯ bə·ša·‘ar sūr wə·haš·šə·li·šîṯ baš·ša·‘ar ’a·ḥar hā·rā·ṣîm mas·sāḥ ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ hab·ba·yiṯ
verses.literal: a third [shall be] at the gate of Sur and a third at the gate behind the guards You are to take turns guarding - - the temple

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֤י הַיָּדוֹת֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְשָֽׁמְר֛וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê hay·yā·ḏō·wṯ bā·ḵem kōl yō·ṣə·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ’el- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: the two divisions - that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard - - the house of the LORD for the king

verses.original: וְהִקַּפְתֶּ֨ם עַל־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ אִ֚ישׁ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־ הַשְּׂדֵר֖וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וִהְי֥וּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּצֵאת֥וֹ וּבְבֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·qap̄·tem ‘al- ham·me·leḵ sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḵê·lāw bə·yā·ḏōw ’îš wə·hab·bā ’el- haś·śə·ḏê·rō·wṯ yū·māṯ wih·yū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ bə·ṣê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·ḇō·’ōw
verses.literal: You must surround . . . the king . . . with weapons in hand and anyone who approaches . . . the ranks must be put to death You must stay close to the king wherever he goes . . .

verses.original: שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ צִוָּה֮ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ way·ya·‘ă·śū kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên ṣiw·wāh ’îš ’eṯ- way·yiq·ḥū ’ă·nā·šāw bā·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ ‘im yō·ṣə·’ê haš·šab·bāṯ way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: So the commanders of hundreds did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered Each of them - took his men those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty . . . and came to Jehoiada the priest

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּאיוֹת אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên way·yit·tên lə·śā·rê ham·mē·yōṯ ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·nîṯ wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·lā·ṭîm lam·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ ’ă·šer ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds - the spears and shields of King David - from the house of the LORD

verses.original: הָרָצִ֜ים אִ֣ישׁ׀ וַיַּעַמְד֨וּ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֗וֹ עַל־ סָבִֽיב׃ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת עַד־ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙
verses.transliteration: hā·rā·ṣîm ’îš way·ya·‘am·ḏū wə·ḵê·lāw bə·yā·ḏōw ‘al- sā·ḇîḇ ham·me·leḵ lam·miz·bê·aḥ wə·lab·bā·yiṯ hay·mā·nîṯ mik·ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ ‘aḏ- haś·śə·mā·lîṯ ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ
verses.literal: And the guards . . . stood with weapons in hand vvv surrounding the king by the altar and the temple from the south side - to the north side of the temple

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א אֶת־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ בֶּן־ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן הַנֵּ֙זֶר֙ וְאֶת־ עָלָיו֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֑הוּ וַיַּכּוּ־ כָ֔ף וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ ben- way·yit·tên han·nê·zer wə·’eṯ- ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ way·yam·li·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw way·yim·šā·ḥu·hū way·yak·kū- ḵāp̄ way·yō·mə·rū yə·ḥî ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then [Jehoiada] brought out - the king’s son put the crown - on him - presented him with the Testimony and proclaimed him king - They anointed him and [the people] clapped their hands and declared Long live the king

verses.original: עֲתַלְיָ֔ה אֶת־ וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע ק֥וֹל הָֽרָצִ֖ין הָעָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’eṯ- wat·tiš·ma‘ qō·wl hā·rā·ṣîn hā·‘ām wat·tā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘ām bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Athaliah - heard the noise from the guards [and] the people she went out to the people in the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ הָעַמּ֜וּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וְהַשָּׂרִ֤ים וְהַחֲצֹֽצְרוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שָׂמֵ֔חַ וְתֹקֵ֖עַ בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֶת־ וַתִּקְרַ֤ע בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתִּקְרָ֖א קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re wə·hin·nêh ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- hā·‘am·mūḏ kam·miš·pāṭ wə·haś·śā·rîm wə·ha·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ’el- ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ śā·mê·aḥ wə·ṯō·qê·a‘ ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ‘ă·ṯal·yāh ’eṯ- wat·tiq·ra‘ bə·ḡā·ḏe·hā wat·tiq·rā qe·šer qā·šer
verses.literal: And she looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar according to the custom The officers and trumpeters were beside the king and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets Then Athaliah - tore her clothes and screamed Treason Treason

verses.original: יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ וַיְצַו֩ שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּיאוֹת פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֣ית לַשְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת הָמֵ֣ת בֶּחָ֑רֶב וְהַבָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ כִּ֚י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אָמַ֣ר אַל־ תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- way·ṣaw śā·rê ham·mē·ʾōṯ pə·qu·ḏê ha·ḥa·yil way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯāh ’el- mib·bêṯ laś·śə·ḏê·rōṯ hā·mêṯ be·ḥā·reḇ wə·hab·bā ’a·ḥă·re·hā kî hak·kō·hên ’ā·mar ’al- tū·maṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Jehoiada the priest - ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army Bring her out - - . . . between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her For the priest had said She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤מוּ לָהּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַתָּב֛וֹא דֶּֽרֶךְ־ הַסּוּסִ֖ים מְב֥וֹא הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית שָֽׁם׃ס וַתּוּמַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śi·mū lāh yā·ḏa·yim wat·tā·ḇō·w de·reḵ- has·sū·sîm mə·ḇō·w ham·me·leḵ bêṯ šām wat·tū·maṯ
verses.literal: So they seized vvv [Athaliah] as she reached . . . the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds . . . and there she was put to death

verses.original: יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶֽת־ וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת הַבְּרִ֗ית בֵּ֤ין יְהוָה֙ וּבֵ֤ין הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָעָ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת לַֽיהוָ֑ה לְעָ֖ם וּבֵ֥ין הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבֵ֥ין הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ’eṯ- way·yiḵ·rōṯ hab·bə·rîṯ bên Yah·weh ū·ḇên ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇên hā·‘ām lih·yō·wṯ Yah·weh lə·‘ām ū·ḇên ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇên hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Then Jehoiada - made a covenant between the LORD and the king . . . and the people that they would be the LORD’s people He also [made a covenant] between the king and the people

verses.original: כָל־ עַם֩ הָאָ֨רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בֵּית־ הַבַּ֜עַל וַֽיִּתְּצֻ֗הוּ אֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתוֹ וְאֶת־ צְלָמָיו֙ שִׁבְּר֣וּ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְאֵ֗ת הָרְג֖וּ מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַבַּ֔עַל לִפְנֵ֣י הַֽמִּזְבְּח֑וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וַיָּ֧שֶׂם פְּקֻדּ֖וֹת עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḵāl ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·ḇō·’ū bêṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yit·tə·ṣu·hū ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯō wə·’eṯ- ṣə·lā·māw šib·bə·rū hê·ṭêḇ wə·’êṯ hā·rə·ḡū mat·tān kō·hên hab·ba·‘al lip̄·nê ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ hak·kō·hên way·yā·śem pə·qud·dō·wṯ ‘al- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down - They smashed the altars - and idols to pieces . . . - and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars And Jehoiada the priest posted guards for the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ֠מֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־ הַכָּרִ֨י וְאֶת־ הָרָצִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֗רֶץ וַיֹּרִ֤ידוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּב֛וֹאוּ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית דֶּֽרֶך־ שַׁ֥עַר הָרָצִ֖ים וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ הַמְּלָכִֽים׃ כִּסֵּ֥א
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hak·kā·rî wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ṣîm wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·rî·ḏū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ mib·bêṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḇō·w·’ū ham·me·leḵ bêṯ de·reḵ- ša·ʿar hā·rā·ṣîm way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm kis·sê
verses.literal: He took with him - the commanders of hundreds - the Carites - the guards - and all the people of the land and they brought - the king {down} from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace by way of the Gate of the Guards Then [Joash] took his seat on the royal throne

verses.original: כָּל־ עַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וַיִּשְׂמַ֥ח וְהָעִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְאֶת־ עֲתַלְיָ֛הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בַחֶ֖רֶב מֶלֶךְ׃ס בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiś·maḥ wə·hā·‘îr šā·qā·ṭāh wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ṯal·yā·hū hê·mî·ṯū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ mɛ·lɛḵ bêṯ
verses.literal: and all the people of the land rejoiced And the city was quiet - because Athaliah had been put to the sword at the royal palace

verses.original: יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ שָׁנִ֖ים בְּמָלְכֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·’āš še·ḇa‘ ben- šā·nîm bə·mā·lə·ḵōw
verses.literal: Joash [was] seven years old . . . when he became king
